# Pinokio-MCP

MCP server for controlling Pinokio — the 1-click localhost cloud for AI apps.

## Key Links
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — full reference
- [README](README.md) — quick start

## Quick Facts
- Discovery: Zeroconf auto-detect Pinokio on the LAN
- Tools: discover_apps, get_app_status, launch_app, stop_app, list_categories
